t: 英格兰的"长议会"通过了"不发表演说"(Vote of no addresses),与国王查理…
te: England's Long Parliament passes the "Vote of No Addresses", breaking off negotiations with King Charles I and thereby …
dz: 英格兰的"长议会"通过了"不发表演说"(Vote of no addresses),与国王查理一世断绝了谈判,并由此为英国内战第二阶段打下基础.
de: England's Long Parliament passes the "Vote of No Addresses", breaking off negotiations with King Charles I and thereby setting the scene for the second phase of the English Civil War.

t: "明斯特和奥斯纳布吕克条约"签署,结束了荷兰和西班牙的冲突.
te: The Treaty of Münster and Osnabrück is signed, ending the conflict between the Netherlands and Spain.
dz: 八十年战争:"明斯特和奥斯纳布吕克条约"签署,结束了荷兰和西班牙的冲突.
de: Eighty Years' War: The Treaty of Münster and Osnabrück is signed, ending the conflict between the Netherlands and Spain.

t: 《明斯特和平》获得批准,西班牙据此承认荷兰的主权.
te: The Peace of Münster is ratified, by which Spain acknowledges Dutch sovereignty.
dz: 《明斯特和平》获得批准,西班牙据此承认荷兰的主权.
de: The Peace of Münster is ratified, by which Spain acknowledges Dutch sovereignty.

t: 一支同盟军的法国和瑞典军队在祖斯马尔斯豪森战役中击败了帝国和巴伐利亚军队.
te: An allied French and Swedish army defeats Imperial and Bavarian forces in the Battle of Zusmarshausen.
dz: 一支同盟军的法国和瑞典军队在祖斯马尔斯豪森战役中击败了帝国和巴伐利亚军队.
de: An allied French and Swedish army defeats Imperial and Bavarian forces in the Battle of Zusmarshausen.

t: 圆头人于第二次英国内战中在迈德斯通战役中击败了卡瓦利人.
te: The Roundheads defeat the Cavaliers at the Battle of Maidstone in the Second English Civil War.
dz: 圆头人于第二次英国内战中在迈德斯通战役中击败了卡瓦利人.
de: The Roundheads defeat the Cavaliers at the Battle of Maidstone in the Second English Civil War.

t: 迈赫迈德四世(1648–1687)接任易卜拉欣一世(1640–1648)为奥斯曼苏丹.
te: Mehmed IV (1648–1687) succeeds Ibrahim I (1640–1648) as Ottoman sultan.
dz: 迈赫迈德四世(1648–1687)接任易卜拉欣一世(1640–1648)为奥斯曼苏丹.
de: Mehmed IV (1648–1687) succeeds Ibrahim I (1640–1648) as Ottoman sultan.

t: 议员们在普雷斯顿战役中击败了一位英国皇家和苏格兰军队.
te: The Parliamentarians defeat a English Royalist and Scottish army in the battle of Preston.
dz: 议员们在普雷斯顿战役中击败了一位英国皇家和苏格兰军队.
de: The Parliamentarians defeat a English Royalist and Scottish army in the battle of Preston.

t: 伦斯战役是三十年战争中最后一次重大军事对抗,为同年10月签署"威斯特伐利亚和平"做出了贡献.
te: The Battle of Lens is the last major military confrontation of the Thirty Years' War, contributing to the signing of th…
dz: 伦斯战役是三十年战争中最后一次重大军事对抗,为同年10月签署"威斯特伐利亚和平"做出了贡献.
de: The Battle of Lens is the last major military confrontation of the Thirty Years' War, contributing to the signing of the Peace of Westphalia in October that year.

t: 第一弗朗德:在伦斯战役成功后,法国首席部长红衣主教马扎林突然下令逮捕巴黎帕莱门派的领导人,激起…
te: First Fronde: In the wake of the successful Battle of Lens, Cardinal Mazarin, Chief Minister of France, suddenly orders…
dz: 弗朗德:第一弗朗德:在伦斯战役成功后,法国首席部长红衣主教马扎林突然下令逮捕巴黎帕莱门派的领导人,激起巴黎其他地区的起义并隔天封锁了街道.
de: The Fronde: First Fronde: In the wake of the successful Battle of Lens, Cardinal Mazarin, Chief Minister of France, suddenly orders the arrest of the leaders of the Parlement of Paris, provoking the rest of Paris to break into insurrection and barricade the streets the next day.

t: 十一周后，保皇党军队向议会军队投降，科尔切斯特围城战结束。
te: The Siege of Colchester ends when Royalist Forces surrender to the Parliamentary Forces after eleven weeks.
dz: 第二次英国内战：十一周后，保皇党军队向议会军队投降，科尔切斯特围城战结束。
de: Second English Civil War: The Siege of Colchester ends when Royalist Forces surrender to the Parliamentary Forces after eleven weeks.

t: 波士顿鞋匠组成了第一个美国劳工组织.
te: Boston shoemakers form the first American labor organization.
dz: 波士顿鞋匠组成了第一个美国劳工组织.
de: Boston shoemakers form the first American labor organization.

t: "威斯特伐利亚和平"签署,标志着"三十年战争"和"八十年战争"的结束.
te: The Peace of Westphalia is signed, marking the end of the Thirty Years' War and the Eighty Years' War.
dz: "威斯特伐利亚和平"签署,标志着"三十年战争"和"八十年战争"的结束.
de: The Peace of Westphalia is signed, marking the end of the Thirty Years' War and the Eighty Years' War.

t: Pride's Purge将保皇党的同情者从议会除名,以便高等法院可以审判国王.
te: Pride's Purge removes royalist sympathizers from Parliament so that the High Court of Justice could put the King on tri…
dz: Pride's Purge将保皇党的同情者从议会除名,以便高等法院可以审判国王.
de: Pride's Purge removes royalist sympathizers from Parliament so that the High Court of Justice could put the King on trial.
